description: This file provides image compression utilities, including a class for handling files with URIs, functions for compressing images, drawing to canvas, and adjusting image sizes based on aspect ratio and resize options.

classes.name: FileWithURI
classes.description: A subclass of File that includes a URI property for object URL.

methods.name: compressImage
methods.description: Compresses an image file based on provided options, returning a Blob.

methods.name: getAdjustedSizes
methods.description: Calculates adjusted width and height for images based on aspect ratio and resize mode.
